description: Step 2 of /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.184.html. ListCons::rewrite_if_unaliased is the one way an old object can gain a pointer to a young one. The collector sets the existing alias bit on each cons cell it copies, so the existing one-bit check refuses the rewrite; no new test on the rewrite path. Blocks carry an age and the collector can classify a pointer as young or old (range test over the few young blocks, collector only). Collections still copy everything. Spike (cons.tenure() in cheney_trace_list): 6,315 tests pass, no pin moves. Signal: runtime test that a cell which survived a collection refuses an in-place rewrite. Fix guides/memory.html section 12's no-write-barrier claim.
title: The collector marks every list cell it keeps as shared
